decisions.title: Composition, density and behavior
decisions.value: Reproduce reference composition, density, controls and behavior, not a Material redesign. Preserve Goatr name/identity; Android owns keyboard, permissions, notifications/widgets and window handling. SVG text/fonts are schematic, not final pixel-perfect typography.

decisions.title: Licensed static Material Icons, not a Material redesign
decisions.value: Wireframe controls use filled Material Icons as inline SVG paths, reusing local 24×24 VectorDrawable artwork plus nine needed icons from google/material-design-icons 49d4db35df873165d6bd6ba09b063c7dafbac2f4. Preserve composition, density, labels, status circles, provider initials, terminal Unicode and keyboard legends. Exact pinned sources and Apache-2.0 attribution are in vendor/material-icons-NOTICE.txt. No icon font, sprite, framework, external asset dependency or production implementation is introduced. Design revision 3 renews review without changing review-store behavior.

decisions.title: Kotlin native Android Views
decisions.value: Use platform text/input/list facilities with custom layout/drawing where necessary. No Compose application framework and no wholesale Telegram application framework import.

decisions.title: API33+ adaptive Android
decisions.value: Minimum Android 13/API33, phones/tablets/foldables, live resizing, hardware keyboard and pointer. Mi 9T/API30 is not an acceptance target. Chosen design geometries are phone 412×915, tablet 1280×800, cover 360×800 and book 840×900; they are not measured iOS layouts or tested devices.

decisions.title: Linux, herdr-core only
decisions.value: The rewrite targets an existing Linux herdr-core instance/session, not Herdr TUI. Official unmodified core must be separately capability/runtime-qualified; no installation or running-service replacement is authorized here. macOS/Windows are excluded. The frozen Heeler visual/behavior reference is unchanged.

decisions.title: Authorized iroh → fixed existing core socket
decisions.value: Android speaks native core over an authenticated, explicitly authorized paired iroh bidirectional stream. The Linux bridge forwards bytes only to the exact host-configured existing core client Unix socket/session; core multiplexes RPC/events/terminal channels. No new SSH/VPN, public TCP, arbitrary socket/command destination, companion PTY, projected terminal service or second domain protocol. Direct preferred, encrypted n0 relay fallback; public rate limits/no SLA accepted, no managed-project secret.

decisions.title: Full-account pairing before socket forwarding
decisions.value: Genuine scan/paste → intended iroh host identity + selected existing core/session + full-account trust preview → explicit confirmation/host authorization. Expiring single-use invitations are identity-bound. Authenticate and authorize each stream before opening or forwarding the socket; core hello is not authentication. Revoke/re-pair refuses new streams and closes actual active iroh streams/connections and corresponding socket handles. It cannot undo accepted commands/writes or kill unrelated programs. DEMO — NOT A PAIRING CODE is not usable enrollment.

decisions.title: Native multi-viewer, detach / Stop / actual Close
decisions.value: Existing terminals from any hc client are usable concurrently. Last active non-observer viewer determines shared size/display; mobile activity may resize desktop views. No exclusive Take Over control. Attach CLOSE detaches only; terminal.interrupt requests Stop and observes stopped/exited/still_working/unknown without escalation. Confirmed terminal.kill ends the actual terminal, even kept, and die_with_parent children; deliberately detached processes are not guaranteed killed. No workspace cascade.

decisions.title: ntfy + UnifiedPush + end-to-end encryption
decisions.value: Use managed ntfy and a distributor app, with payload encryption. Authenticated-only/HMAC-only delivery is insufficient. No Goatr FCM sender service and no APNs relay reuse. Android system surfaces adapt outcomes rather than claiming Dynamic Island or portable lock-screen widgets.

decisions.title: Fresh pairing, clean protocol/data cutover
decisions.value: Fresh pairing is acceptable; remove obsolete production code and callers at the later cutover, not in this gate. Preserve existing source, installation data and caches until explicit replacement. Do not build compatibility/migration layers. docs/ was intentionally empty/deleted and stays deleted.

decisions.title: Qualify existing implementations and actual licenses
decisions.value: No full client is a drop-in base. Qualify useful ownership, IME, framing and recovery before reuse. Comply with actual revision/file notices, not assumed relicensing. Imported assets here are Heeler Apache-2.0 images, Google Material Icons Apache-2.0 static path artwork and exact Pixelmatch ISC source; donor application code is not imported.

decisions.title: Only public static reference evidence
decisions.value: No observed iOS execution is available. Owned Android emulators may suffice later but do not establish physical-phone performance, battery or background behavior. This studio does not run provider sessions, transport, notification or native runtime scenarios. Source comments reporting upstream checks are upstream reports, not Goatr evidence.

decisions.title: Bounded later provider calls only
decisions.value: Later acceptance may use existing configured accounts for small bounded prompts. No new signup/subscription, credential collection or provider call occurs in this studio gate. Missing later provider credentials remain named live-qualification blockers, never fixture-passed.

decisions.title: Studio review before production rewrite
decisions.value: User reviews this complete localhost studio first. Then implement genuine pairing → live Console → real terminal input/reconnect as the first working APK checkpoint. Matched captures are reviewed at checkpoints before UI expands; silence is not approval.

decisions.title: One owned runtime / connection / store
decisions.value: Preserve useful GoatrRuntime ownership and StateFlow behavior: Views observe one application-owned runtime, connection and store, never create a second endpoint/store. Requalify SecretStore, genuine pairing, native IME, strict bounded framing and no-replay/recovery. Remove Compose-specific state with every caller, not only its Gradle plugin.

decisions.title: Narrow authenticated native-byte bridge
decisions.value: Retain qualified pairing/iroh lifetime guarantees, not old Goatr v2 envelopes, receipts or provider/TUI dispatch. One authorized iroh stream maps to one direct socket connection to the exact host-selected client endpoint. Bounded buffers/backpressure preserve native bytes. Never invoke hc connect or ordinary CLI probes: connect_or_start can start core. Unavailable socket means unavailable, never autostart. No arbitrary filesystem API, remote shell endpoint or companion runtime replacement.

decisions.title: Native hello, framing, events and documents
decisions.value: Start newline JSON-RPC 2.0 hello {generation:1, framed:true}; its reply is still newline JSON. Check generation, core.id/name, advertised methods and framed/attach/events/status capabilities before switching to [channel u32 LE][kind u8][length u32 LE][payload]: 9-byte header, 16 MiB payload cap. Preserve DATA/CREDIT/CLOSE/RESIZE/FOCUS/FACTS, 256 KiB initial stream credit acknowledged only for consumed bytes; parse event JSON lines incrementally across frames. AUTOMATIC_INPUT kind 6 requires hello and attach confirmation, else DATA; tag generated replies at source. Observer resize_notifications also needs negotiated attach confirmation; apply RESIZE before DATA, otherwise use size events. events.subscribe atomically returns terminal snapshot/seq/channel; subscribe before doc.get. Read herdr-app organization only, never mutate its private schema. Refetch documents after doc events, missed and reconnect.

decisions.title: Any native client, existing sessions, no Goatr ownership restriction
decisions.value: Adopt the selected already-running hc instance/session and enumerate all accessible existing terminals, including CLI/other-client-created terminals. No private isolated Goatr core, mandatory Goatr label/reporter, wrapper or custom fork. Other native clients/desktop apps may attach concurrently. Disconnecting Goatr detaches its viewers only: do not recreate/kill the session or disrupt programs/other clients. Preserve names/labels/desktop documents except explicit supported user action. Host config exposes exact endpoint(s); mobile confirms saved selection/identity, never supplies arbitrary socket paths. Test-resource ownership controls cleanup only, never product access.

decisions.title: Fresh native baseline; unknown outcomes never replay
decisions.value: Each reconnect creates a new native connection: fresh hello, expected paired-host/core/session identity validation, events.subscribe snapshot/seq, new event/attach channels and refetched documents. seq restarts per core process and channels are connection-local, not a durable cursor. Names/aliases may be reused; bind paired host + core.id + session/terminal address and current process evidence (plus added-machine core identity where relevant). Kept terminals may acquire a replacement shell, never a replayed task. JSON-RPC IDs correlate replies, NOT durable idempotency receipts; never automatically retry uncertain input/keys/send/run/kill/file writes/Git/provider effects, even spawn_pending. Show unknown outcome and resynchronize before deliberate next action.

decisions.title: Required outcomes exceed native primitives
decisions.value: Core provides terminal.run argv/line/cwd/env/labels, file.read/write/edit and bounded connection-bound machine.exec, not workspace/tab/account/Git/Usage/structured-Chat APIs. Implement program/PATH/home/directory/process evidence, provider transcript pagination/binary images, shared Account files and Git worktree/Changes workflows through those primitives where sufficient; limits/ambiguity remain visible. file.read is capped UTF-8 line reading, not general byte ranges/stat/list. machine.exec has bounded stdin/output/timeouts and cancellation, not persistent jobs. Workspace/Tab cards are adoption/display groups from read-only herdr-app, labels/parents/directories; derived-workspace rename has no native API and an optional desktop rename control is not a hidden requirement.

decisions.title: Unresolved implementation gap: atomic 64 MiB staging
decisions.value: Private temporary staging up to 64 MiB, progress/cancel and atomic completion remain required. Native terminal.put allows only 8 MiB raw and writes directly with create_new/write_all into terminal-owned state; it is NOT the 64 MiB chunk/progress/atomic contract. A bounded guarded staging workflow using available native file/exec primitives still needs design/implementation/qualification later; no invented companion upload API or silently reduced limit.

decisions.title: Unresolved implementation gap: guarded config write / Undo
decisions.value: Keep exact bytes/path/nonexistence preview, explicit confirmation, race-safe compare-before-write, conflict refusal and partial Undo visibility. Native file.write is atomic replacement but lacks expected-content CAS; file.edit unique-match all-or-none edits are not expected-bytes/nonexistence guards. A guarded host-file workflow through available native primitives is unresolved later implementation work; read-then-write alone cannot claim these guarantees.

decisions.title: Five structured provider Chats remain required
decisions.value: Claude Code, Codex, Pi, OMP and Grok Build structured Chat require provider-native transcripts plus exact process/session evidence and guarded actions. Native terminal facts/status/I/O do not supply transcript/dialog APIs. Core OpenCode Chat stays reference_unavailable at the frozen Heeler pin; OpenCode can still run in a real terminal. Accounts are host JSON, Launch Presets device-local; Templates use templates.list and terminal.run, not template/account/preset CRUD APIs.

decisions.title: Exact Ghostty native engine / Zig boundary
decisions.value: Ghostty 82938b633ba646db38591d969c3c526332bd7e65 under libghostty-spm 7e45d27160f9b34aca9ca5c9820e9207482f9f04, Zig 0.16.0. Android build of this exact pin is UNVERIFIED. Use a small JNI/Zig adapter and custom Android View, not UIKit/Metal or old grid→VT. Include styles, key encoders, IME, scrollback, native selection, links and Kitty images. Virtual placements and animation require native Zig graphics_unicode.zig placement iteration and ImageStorage.animationTick, not a Kotlin reimplementation. Reference engine has no Sixel.

decisions.title: No client imports masquerading as parity
decisions.value: Bellterm custom TerminalView.kt is an Apache-2.0 View/IME/gesture donor, but its grid→VT/no-inline-image backend is not chosen. Older kruttan/Heeler Android fork is AGPL at its revision and provides JNI/graphics references but loses style/cursor/image layers and needs IME/UTF-8 corrections. Flutter herdr-mobile is workflow research with documented read-only terminal/provider limits, not the chosen stack. Telegram is a GPL application, not a supported standalone UI SDK; TDLib is not its UI toolkit.

decisions.title: Disconnected encrypted delivery is separate required work
decisions.value: A transparent phone↔core tunnel and live events do not deliver notifications while the phone is disconnected. A separately implemented/qualified supporting host service must observe running core status/turns, manage durable decisions/registrations/device seen state and send end-to-end encrypted managed ntfy/UnifiedPush payloads. Its health/extensions and Android permission/distributor state stay distinct from bridge/core health. No mandated copy of the reference Node helper, no HMAC-only substitute, APNs reuse or Goatr FCM sender.

decisions.title: Frozen source research ≠ installed/runtime choice
decisions.value: herdrdev/herdr-core 9ce385d9c8abb041dd4437476d770365b3fb5282, declared source 0.1.18, protocol generation 1, is the static research baseline only. It is NOT an installed version, release-artifact verification, selected runtime-compatible version, or permission to install/update. Later authorized Linux capability/runtime qualification must freeze the actual official core used. Older reference runtime anchors are historical/non-target evidence, not a runtime pair.

decisions.title: Source fixtures establish intent, not execution
decisions.value: Public screenshots, DemoScreenshotMode, ChatFixtures and plugin/test-vectors establish intended deterministic states. They are not observed iOS execution or live-provider pass results. Fixture capture, emulator capture and physical capture are distinct badges; wireframes are never genuine runtime captures.

decisions.title: Actual Android interaction and performance
decisions.value: UI Automator drives actual app/system UI; Macrobenchmark and Perfetto measure release-like scrolling, keyboard transitions, Agent switching and terminal output on a recorded environment. Emulator results remain emulator results; no physical battery/background claim follows.

decisions.title: Matched approved Android goldens only
decisions.value: Same-state, same-size Android captures become regression goldens after user design approval. Cross-platform images diagnose geometry/typography/control differences; no arbitrary whole-image percentage declares parity. Crops are deliberate, coordinates visible, no silent resizing.

decisions.title: Acceptance includes any-client existing-session effects
decisions.value: Pair intended host/account/configured core/session; discover a CLI-created existing terminal, attach/input once from Android and observe the same effects from CLI/another native client. Preserve existing names/labels/organization, shared multi-viewer lifetimes and no-replay on disconnect/reconnect. Revoke closes real stream/socket handles before more access. Verify uncertain input/run/kill/writes remain unknown rather than retried, guarded prompts stay current, displayed Close scope is honest and disconnected push opens the identity-bound target. No runtime scenario is exercised at this gate.

decisions.title: Graphics / input acceptance matrix
decisions.value: Check fragmented VT, Unicode/wide cells, complete styles/cursors, key press/repeat/release, CJK composition, bracketed paste, mouse/alternate-screen scrolling and Kitty layers/placeholders/animation. A native-library load or cell dump alone does not pass.

decisions.title: Review staleness is a design boundary
decisions.value: Each screen/variant has independent unreviewed, accepted or changes_requested notes. Successive designRevision changes and partial renewal retain every unrenewed variant's note, previous state and original review revision, while invalidating previous acceptance and showing Review needs renewal. Export does not pass application features. Increment designRevision whenever geometry, variants, behavior annotations or associated references change.

research.finding: hc connect forwards bytes only after client::connect_or_start and has no no-autostart option. The bridge must directly connect the exact host-configured already-running client Unix socket. HC_SESSION/HC_SOCKET/config path resolution belongs to host configuration, not an arbitrary mobile socket selector.
research.qualification: Pinned static implementation evidence; no CLI command or service was invoked. Ordinary CLI calls/schema probes may also autostart.

research.title: Native hello and multiplexed framing
research.finding: Plain newline hello/reply precedes framed mode; generation/core/method/features are negotiated. Header is channel u32 LE + kind u8 + length u32 LE (9 bytes), payload max 16 MiB. 256 KiB stream credit is replenished for consumed data. DATA/CREDIT/CLOSE/RESIZE/FOCUS/FACTS and negotiated AUTOMATIC_INPUT remain native; event DATA contains incremental JSON lines, not one event/frame.
research.qualification: Static protocol evidence at the frozen source; Android native parser/emulator/backpressure interoperability is unqualified. No Goatr v2 envelope/second mux.

research.title: Atomic subscribe baseline and fresh document reads
research.finding: events.subscribe atomically installs subscription and returns terminal snapshot/seq/event channel. Subscribe before doc.get; document events contain name/version, not content. Unfiltered document events/refetch after missed/reconnect are needed; core seq restarts per process, channels per connection. doc.get/set are opaque versioned JSON, not workspace semantics. Read desktop herdr-app organization only.
research.qualification: Pinned handler/schema evidence, not exercised recovery or permission scope. Fresh hello/core identity, snapshot, channels and documents are required; JSON-RPC IDs are not durable idempotency receipts.

research.title: Full account and native-machine authority
research.finding: API access can run commands, read/change account-accessible files/credentials, control terminals/server and reach machines already configured in core. No native per-client API auth or permission scopes; sessions/templates/observer attach are not isolation. Fixed socket forwarding limits destination, not shell-equivalent account authority.
research.qualification: Pairing disclosure/admission/revocation are required bridge design, not core features or exercised security. Close actual revoked peer streams/socket handles; cannot undo accepted effects or guarantee removal of malicious account-level persistence. No inherent root claim.

research.title: Actual native methods, not invented product APIs
research.finding: terminal.run supports cwd/env/argv/line/labels/parent/template; templates.list lists templates with parse errors. file.read/write/edit and bounded connection-bound machine.exec enable required application workflows; no workspace/tab/account/preset/template-CRUD/Git/Usage/structured-transcript API family. file.read is capped UTF-8 line-oriented, not binary/byte-range/directory discovery.
research.qualification: Complete pinned method table/types/handlers establish primitive boundaries, not finished product workflows or runtime compatibility.

research.title: Any-client terminal viewers, not takeover
research.finding: Non-observer native viewers coexist; last active focus/input/resize sets shared dimensions/display. Observe prevents that viewer typing/resizing, with optional resize negotiation. Attach CLOSE detaches; interrupt observes without kill escalation; kill ends terminal including kept and eligible die_with_parent children, not guaranteed detached nohup/setsid descendants. Existing CLI/other-client terminals need no Goatr ownership/label.
research.qualification: Pinned static native lifetime evidence; mobile disconnect must preserve session/programs/other clients. No exclusive Take Over, workspace cascade or Goatr-private runtime.

research.title: Required 64 MiB staging vs terminal.put 8 MiB
research.finding: terminal.put accepts 8 MiB raw and creates/writes terminal-owned state directly, cleaned up with terminal; it is not required private atomic 64 MiB staging with progress/cancel. Native exec/file bounds also matter for a later bounded workflow.
research.qualification: UNRESOLVED later implementation/qualification gap, not an excluded outcome, reduced limit or fabricated companion upload API.

research.title: Atomic file replacement is not expected-bytes CAS
research.finding: file.write atomically replaces but has no expected-content compare-and-set; file.edit requires each old string exactly once and disjoint edits, not the reference exact bytes/nonexistence guard. doc.set version CAS applies only to opaque core docs, not arbitrary provider files.
research.qualification: UNRESOLVED later guarded Host-file implementation/qualification work. Required preview/confirmation/conflict refusal/partial Undo cannot be claimed from stock write/edit or unsafe read-then-write.

research.title: Adopt desktop organization without owning sessions
research.finding: Frozen Heeler adopts core terminals into Console from desktop herdr-app document, herdr.space/herdr.tab labels and derived directory groups. This is client projection, not workspace/tab backend objects. Existing names/labels/documents remain intact; optional desktop rename is a separate non-guaranteed control.
research.qualification: Source-derived organization intent; read-only desktop adoption, not an established writable cross-app schema or mandatory desktop app dependency.

Preserve outcomes without mandating the reference Node service implementation.
research.qualification: Required later supporting-service/application work, separately health-checked and runtime-qualified. No service installation/replacement or background/provider call at studio gate.
